other_deposits: PXD069170 (plasma proteomics), PR002719 (metabolomics); skeletal-muscle RNA-seq re-used from Botella et al. (not in GSE308252, S9.3.13.p1)
assay: bulk RNA-seq, Illumina stranded mRNA, NextSeq 2000; Salmon v1.8.0 -> tximport -> DESeq2 (S9.3.14.p1, S9.3.15.p1)
sample_inclusion: Cohort 3: 11 recruited, 9 with both biopsies sequenced (6 M, 3 F) (S9.2.1.3.p2)
sample_exclusion: 1 male declined the second biopsy; 1 female sample compromised by room-temperature exposure (S9.2.1.3.p2)
primary_estimand: Within-person change in subcutaneous abdominal adipose tissue gene expression 3 h after a maximal graded treadmill exercise test versus a resting biopsy 7-10 days before (paired, N=9).

planned_contrasts.name: post_vs_pre
planned_contrasts.definition: adipose 3 h post-GXT vs pre, paired by participant, DESeq2 controlling for subject

blocking_or_covariance.locator: S9.3.15.p1 ('controlling for each subject in the linear model')

matrix_scale: Salmon/tximport gene-level counts as stored in DESeq2 (GEO: 'raw counts from DESeq2')
paper_formula: ~ subject + time (per experiment / per intensity; exact formula not printed)

paper_threshold.adjustment: BH (DESeq2 default padj; method not named in paper)

enrichment: GSEA (clusterProfiler, GO BP via msigdbr) ranked by DESeq2 Wald statistic (S9.3.15.p1)
